# Agent workflow

## Context levels

Read down this list and **stop when you know enough**.

| Level | File                                        | Budget                                                           |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| L0    | `CLAUDE.md`                                 | 120 lines                                                        |
| L1    | `docs/PROGRESS.md`, `docs/board/BOARD.md`   | 100 lines, and 200 for the board, whose Done table keeps 20 rows |
| L2    | the `CLAUDE.md` of the directory you are in | 50 lines                                                         |
| L3    | your story's `story.md`, then your card     | on demand                                                        |
